messages:
Priya M.: Hey team, spotted a weird double-charge on the March AWS Marketplace invoice for reseller BlueOrbit — two overage lines for the SAME subscription. Can someone confirm before I open a credit?

Liam B.: ugh. invoice id?

Priya M.: invoice: INV-2025-03-00972, lines: 
```
Line 117: SUB-8765 | metering.dimension=token_usage | qty=12,300 | charge=123.00
Line 118: SUB-8765 | metering.dimension=token_usage_total | qty=12,300 | charge=123.00
```
Looks like identical qty/amount but different dimension ids.

Sam K.: @Liam B. could be our billing mapping rule duplicating when both dimension and dimension_total come in from AWS raw usage. We had a late ingestion spike on 2025-03-05.

Liam B.: checking ingestion logs now. If both dimensions arrived, our aggregation might not dedupe. Give me 10.

billing-bot: Ingestion job run: marketplace-us-east-1-usage-ingest v2025.03.05 completed. 72,482 events processed. 29 events flagged as "ambiguous-dimension".

Jules P.: BlueOrbit pinged their AM about a surprise credit request from a customer. They escalated to us for a quick fix.

Liam B.: found it — two separate AWS meterDimensions: `token_usage` and `token_usage_total`. Downstream transform created two invoice lines because our normalization rule only collapsed exact dimension matches.

Priya M.: ok. what's the recommended action? full credit? partial?

Sam K.: we should credit duplicate line (the dimension_secondary) only if we can prove it's not additive. For this subscription, usage_id MATCHES and timestamps overlap exactly, so it's duplicate. Suggest issuing credit for Line 118 amount $123.00 and mark mapping rule for fix.

Liam B.: I can prepare journal entry and draft credit memo. Need approval from accounting.

Priya M.: tagging approvals: @accounting-team (not on Slack here), but leaving thread for audit trail. Sam/Jules, can you add a short note to Partner Ops ticket that we credited duplicate marketplace metering?

Jules P.: will do. I'll update ticket CHANNEL-4521 with: "Credited duplicate AWS metering dimension for SUB-8765 — issued $123.00 credit to BlueOrbit. Root cause: dual-dimension ingestion; normalization rule updated to dedupe by usage_id+subscription."

billing-bot: Suggested remediation: add transform step: dedupe_by = ["usage_id","subscription_id","metering_dimension"], prefer_primary_dimensions = ["token_usage","embeddings_usage"] — created PR #801 in billing-ingest repo.

Priya M.: thanks. Liam, please attach credit memo and JE to the ticket and cc finance mailbox. Once accounting confirms, we'll push the credit.

Liam B.: will do. drafting memo now. ETA 45m. :thumbsup:

Sam K.: also scheduling a replay of 2025-03-05 window to ensure no other subscriptions impacted. I'll post results here.

Priya M.: great. thanks all — closing loop in ~1h after JE attached.

Liam B.: draft done, attaching snippet to ticket: 
```
Credit Memo: CM-2025-04-112
Customer: BlueOrbit
Original Invoice: INV-2025-03-00972
Amount Credited: $123.00
Reason: Duplicate metering dimension (token_usage_total)
```

Jules P.: noted in CHANNEL-4521. BlueOrbit rep acknowledged, says their downstream customer will see the refund shortly. :relieved:

billing-bot: Incident postmortem checklist created: PM-2025-03-dupe-metering. Assigned to Sam K., due 2025-04-10.

Priya M.: awesome. leaving for accounting signoff.

(END)
